The authoritative player reconciliation is durable, the locked legacy-versus-vNext historical benchmark is reproducible on 5,622 player-origin snapshots and 20,094 player-origin-lead rows per model across 25 legal folds, and the recorded benchmark has zero target failures, zero fold failures and passing historical information-boundary safeguards.

Release constraint: TASK-006 and the TASK-007 TASK-006 export must not be promoted.
